Replaces the 20 mm run default, which only an ADC beside the MCU could meet (A6: SAI3 MCLK on PD14, away from the input RC, SLES177B 10.1.6 p21). Run lead 2026-09-26: vias 1 -> 2 so R27 can sit within 3 mm of U1.61 (clock_source_termination) and SCKI takes one F-B-F hop with a qualifying reference_transition cap; a 14.7 mm unterminated source leg defeats the resistor. Codex: a source-damped, reference-clean 80 mm clock beats a shorter one with a broken reference. Run lead 2026-09-26: 80 -> 90 after (iv) F.Cu north measured 85.8/0 and closes the QSPI escapes, and (ii) east B.Cu measured 70.9/2 but breaks crystal_keepout (0.723 mm) and SW1's lane; the north B.Cu hop measures 86.3/2. Physics: 86 mm is about 0.55-0.6 ns one-way on FR4 against the 2-3 ns edge, source-terminated by R27 33 R at 2.3 mm from U1.61, both transitions capped (C62 at via A, C61 at via B); the 80 figure was a placement-fitted lead number, not a vendor limit. PCM1808 SCKI duty and thresholds verified at bring-up per clock_source_termination.

Before that: DOUT is 2.8 MHz data received at the MCU, and 34 mm is a small fraction of its edge; 40 mm, 1 via. Replaces the 25 mm run default (A6: ADC_DOUT short, SLES177B 10.1.5 p21).
